content_metadata.description: A recorded interview featuring Chee Aun, a front-end developer, discussing his projects and experiences with mapping technologies.

qAndA.answer: His HackerWeb mobile app, his bus route app and his personal life tracker.
qAndA.question: What are some of Chee Aun's most popular projects on Github?

qAndA.answer: He uses React mainly for work. For his personal projects, he writes all the code by hand.
qAndA.question: Does Chee Aun use any popular framework for his projects?

qAndA.answer: He finds that vector maps offer smoother animations, better zooming capabilities and a more efficient way to handle different zoom levels.
qAndA.question: Why does Chee Aun prefer vector maps over raster maps?

qAndA.answer: He finds the usability to be poor, even though they have access to good data.
qAndA.question: What is Chee Aun's opinion on Singapore's street directory map apps?

qAndA.answer: He has been trying to do this, finding their data to be the only good thing about their maps.
qAndA.question: What does Chee Aun think of getting the data from Singapore's street directory and plotting it on a Google Map?
